title: Medicos Beauty puts its colour expertise on display in a 200 ml Carita jar
summary: Medicos Beauty designed and manufactured the 200 ml jar for Maison Carita's restructuring hair mask, meeting the technical challenge of harmonising a deep-black shade, mass-tinted across all three components, though made from different materials, without resorting to carbon black. The cap, in PP, features a bespoke Carita engraving cut directly into the tooling. The jar, in R-PET containing 30% mechanically recycled material, is mass-tinted in translucent black and carries a gold label... - Industry buzz
